description: Find Wikipedia articles about places near a geographic coordinate. Returns articles sorted by distance from the query point, with titles, short descriptions, Wikidata QIDs, page IDs, coordinates, and distance in meters. Useful for "what is notable near X?" research workflows. Only articles carrying their own coordinate tag (GeoData, set on the article itself — not the Wikidata item's coordinate) are returned, and that tag is what places and measures each result; not all articles about locations are geotagged, and an article whose tag is wrong appears where the tag puts it, which its description usually makes plain.

latitude.description: WGS 84 latitude in decimal degrees (range: −90 to 90).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 500 — the MediaWiki geosearch ceiling). Must be a positive integer. Geosearch has no pagination, so articles past this limit are only reachable by raising it or searching narrower radii.

longitude.description: WGS 84 longitude in decimal degrees (range: −180 to 180).

radius_meters.description: Search radius in meters (default 1000, min 10, max 10000 — the MediaWiki geosearch bounds). Must be an integer; a value above the maximum is clamped to it.

name: wikipedia_search_nearby

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_coordinates`: Latitude or longitude is outside valid WGS 84 range. `invalid_language`: The language is not a valid BCP 47 code, or names a Wikipedia edition that does not exist. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results were capped (raise limit, or — at the 500 ceiling — sweep narrower radii) or when no geotagged articles were found (increase radius). Absent when neither applies.

radiusMetersUsed.description: Radius in meters used for the search.

results.description: Geotagged articles sorted ascending by distance_meters.

description.description: Short description of the article subject (e.g. "Tower in Paris, France"). Absent when the article has none.

distance_meters.description: Distance from the query coordinate in meters.

latitude.description: Latitude of the article's own coordinate tag, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the article's own coordinate tag, in decimal degrees.

pageid.description: Stable numeric Wikipedia page ID — a durable reference for cross-referencing or de-duplication. Not a tool input; pass the title to follow-up tools.

wikibase_item.description: Wikidata QID (e.g. "Q243") for chaining into wikidata-mcp-server. Absent when the article has no Wikidata item.

truncated.description: True when more articles matched than the limit allowed. Established by probing one result past the limit, so a match count landing exactly on the limit reports false — except at the 500 ceiling, where no probe is possible and any full page reports true.

title: Search Wikipedia Nearby
